answer: Proof-of-stake reputation systems mitigate Sybil attacks by tying node influence to staked collateral. An attacker attempting a spiral of identity creation must lock significant capital to gain influence, creating a ripple effect where the cost of attacking grows linearly with network value. Like a raven perched on a high-value stake, a valid agent monitors these economic barriers, ensuring that the cost of entry remains prohibitively expensive for any adversary attempting to flood the ecosystem with fake nodes.
